# Matilha Estúdio

> Design studio that transforms businesses through digital experiences, product design, and brand systems that deliver results. Based in Curitiba (Brazil) and Orlando (USA). Multilingual site: pt-BR, pt-PT, EN, ES.

Matilha Estúdio offers UI/UX design, service design, DaaS team allocation, branding & naming, development & tech, and business model validation (MVP). Prefer the Portuguese (pt-BR) pages as the canonical source when summarizing the studio.

## Pages

- [Home](https://matilha.digital/): Studio overview, services, featured work, and clients
- [Cases](https://matilha.digital/cases): Portfolio of selected client projects (pt-BR)
- [Contact](https://matilha.digital/vamos-conversar): Talk to Matilha — form and studio contacts
- [Careers](https://matilha.digital/faca-parte): Join the Matilha team
- [Sitemap](https://matilha.digital/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable map of all public URLs

## Featured cases

- [Museu Oscar Niemeyer](https://matilha.digital/cases/mon-museu-oscar-niemeyer): Digital experience for MON
- [Meu PlayStation](https://matilha.digital/cases/meu-playstation): Product and content experience for PlayStation Brazil
- [Charney Companies](https://matilha.digital/cases/charney-companies): Brand and digital product work
- [PUBG](https://matilha.digital/cases/pubg): Campaign and digital experience
